verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting model directly delivers data residency choice: users can run Penpot in their own private cloud, on-premise, or any environment, giving full control over where data lives, and this extends to the MCP server which can also be self-deployed rather than routed through third-party clouds. Missing for 10: no first-party managed 'choose a region' feature for the SaaS-hosted offering, and no independent verification of self-hosting data-control claims beyond docs.
